housing.summary: Numbeo reported a crowdsourced average of EUR 1,430.77 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Lisbon city centre on 2 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Lisbon. A deposit norm in months and evidence establishing a main local rental portal were not found.

banking.summary: Novo Banco's official account-opening document lists personal identification, tax identification, proof of address, and proof of profession and employer: https://www.novobanco.pt/content/dam/novobancopublicsites/docs/pdfs/abertura-conta/abertura%20conta.pdf.

schools.summary: The Lisbon international-schools directory lists IB, British, American, and French curricula: https://www.international-schools-database.com/in/lisbon.

legal_admin.summary: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens staying longer than three months must request the EU citizen registration certificate within 30 days after their first three months; Lisbon residents apply to Lisbon City Council and attend in person: https://informacoeseservicos.lisboa.pt/servicos/detalhe/registo-de-cidadao-da-uniao-europeia-certificado.
legal_admin.registration_step: For an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen staying over three months, request the EU citizen registration certificate from Lisbon City Council within 30 days after the first three months and attend in person.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign citizen can request a Portuguese NIF online through e-balcao via a legal representative or in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop; the Tax and Customs Authority lists the required documents: https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/en/tax-information/getting-started-in-portugal/tax-identification-number/apply-for-your-nif/Pages/default.aspx.

transport.summary: Metropolitano de Lisboa lists the Navegante Metropolitano monthly pass at EUR 40: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/buy/. IMT states that EU/EEA licences remain valid until their stated expiry; rules for other licences depend on issuing country, and convention/reciprocity-country licence holders who become resident can drive for 90 days while applying for exchange, cannot drive on that licence after 90 days, and need a practical test to exchange after two years: https://www.imt-ip.pt/condutores/informacoes-gerais/quero-ser-condutor/tenho-carta-de-conducao-estrangeira/. A foreign national receives an SNS user number at a public health centre or hospital; for SNS cost coverage, the record should include identification, a Portuguese NIF, full Portuguese address, and a valid residence permit: https://www2.gov.pt/en/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Rules depend on issuing country. EU/EEA licences remain valid until their stated expiry. For convention or reciprocity-country licences, apply for exchange within 90 days after residence authorization; driving on the foreign licence stops after 90 days, and exchange after two years requires a practical test.
transport.healthcare_registration: Obtain an SNS user number at a public health centre or hospital; associate identification, Portuguese NIF, full Portuguese address, and a valid residence permit for SNS cost coverage.
